title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-cjbc: Ack::from_bytes_for extracts window bit from wrong position (FRAGMENT_N=6, should be 7)
description:
In `rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs` line 287, `Ack::from_bytes_for` extracts the W (window) bit via:
```rust
let window = (data[1] >> FRAGMENT_N) & 1;  // FRAGMENT_N = 6, i.e. >> 6
```
But `write_to` (line 252, 264) writes the window bit at position 7 via `self.window << 7`. This means `0x40` (window 0, C=1) is incorrectly parsed as window=1 because `(0x40 >> 6) & 1 == 1`.

**Fix**: Change line 287 to `let window = (data[1] >> 7) & 1;`

**Impact**: The `exercise_controls` test in `fragmentation_vectors.rs` fails at line 284 for window=0 ACK success (`7840`). This is pre-existing (reproduces on parent commit). The test currently fails on both the reviewed commit and its parent.

**Verification**: `cargo test -p lichen-schc --test fragmentation_vectors` reproduces the failure.
